clinicalPearls: Macrogols are first line chronic constipation therapy
Lactulose doubles in hepatic encephalopathy (acid traps ammonia)
Never give antimotility drugs in bloody diarrhoea or toxic megacolon
Screen for tuberculosis before anti TNF therapy in IBD
reference.pathophysiology: Stool water follows osmotic load and transit time, so constipation and diarrhoea drugs manipulate luminal water, motility neurochemistry (opioid, serotonergic) or secretion channels. IBD instead is immune dysregulation against gut microbiota where topical aminosalicylates, broad immunosuppression and cytokine or trafficking blockade restore mucosal healing in escalating potency and risk.
